resources.string:
1. The launcher icon becomes "%1$s" and opens an ordinary web page. Some launchers move the icon off the home screen; drag it back from the app list.

2. To get in: at the top of the page, pull down and hold for about %2$s s; when you feel a light vibration, verification pops up — use your fingerprint or screen lock.

3. After you tap Enable the app closes right away; from then on it can only be opened from "%1$s". By default the app also locks again when it goes to the background or the screen turns off (adjustable in settings); locking also stops background playback.
